entities.name: Eladamri
entities.description: Leader of the Skyshroud elves of Rath who led the resistance against the evincars and the Coalition on Dominaria, and died with Liin Sivi in the final battle against Yawgmoth.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: The plane where Eladamri was born, home of the Skyshroud Forest and the Stronghold.

entities.name: Skyshroud Forest
entities.description: The Rathi forest of the elves, long opposed to the Stronghold.

entities.name: Stronghold
entities.description: The Phyrexian-ruled fortress of Rath, home of the evincars, guarded by the Portcullis.

entities.name: Avila
entities.description: Eladamri's daughter, murdered by a Phyrexian agent and turned into Belbe.

entities.name: Belbe
entities.description: The Phyrexian emissary made from Avila's corpse, who turns against the regime and helps Eladamri escape.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: The evincar of the Stronghold who disappeared during Weatherlight's attack.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: The candidate for evincar who attacks the Skyshroud and later becomes the new Evincar.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: A skyship whose crew allies with Eladamri.

entities.name: Gerrard Capashen
entities.description: The Weatherlight captain declared the Korvecdal by the Oracle en-Vec.

entities.name: Oracle en-Vec
entities.description: A prophet who declares Gerrard and then Eladamri the Korvecdal.

entities.name: Greven il-Vec
entities.description: A Stronghold officer who tortures Eladamri.

entities.name: Takara en-Dal
entities.description: A former rebel leader and daughter of Starke, freed by Eladamri and killed in the bombardment of Llanowar.

entities.name: Liin Sivi
entities.description: A rebel who stays at Eladamri's side and dies with him; they fell in love.

entities.name: Llanowar
entities.description: The Dominarian elf forest bombarded with plague bombs.

entities.name: King Fhedusil
entities.description: The king of Llanowar who refused to heed Eladamri and died in the bombardment.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: A planeswalker worshipped as a goddess by Llanowar's elves who relocates Eladamri to Keld.

entities.name: Koilos
entities.description: The site of a battle for a permanent portal to Phyrexia.

entities.name: Coalition
entities.description: The alliance of Dominarian peoples fighting the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Keldons
entities.description: The native people of Keld whom Eladamri unites with the elves.

entities.name: Keldon Necropolis
entities.description: The besieged site where Keldon dead were prophesied to rise.

entities.name: Doyenne Tajamin
entities.description: A Keldon whose sacred cudgel triggers a volcanic eruption and flood.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: The swampy region with the Stronghold where the final battle begins.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: The Phyrexian leader who emerges through the planar portal as a Black Cloud of Death.

entities.name: Commander Grizzlegom
entities.description: The new leader of the metathran army.

entities.name: Sister Nadeen Dormet
entities.description: A stone dwarf rock druid who tunnels into the volcano.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Found as a decapitated but still living head in the Stronghold throne room.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders of Dominaria whose forces Eladamri fights.

events.summary: Eladamri's wife dies in a fire that destroyed their home, likely perpetrated by Stronghold agents.
events.quote: His wife died in a fire that destroyed their home.

events.summary: The Oracle declares Gerrard the Korvecdal, convincing Eladamri to aid the Weatherlight crew.
events.quote: The Oracle's proclamation convinced Eladamri to aid the Weatherlight crew in their rescue mission

events.summary: Eladamri leads a frontal assault on the Stronghold but cannot breach the Portcullis and calls a retreat.
events.quote: Eladamri realized that the day was lost and was forced to call a retreat.

events.summary: Eladamri learns that his daughter Avila was murdered in her sleep by a Phyrexian agent who stole her body.
events.quote: his daughter, Avila, had been murdered in her sleep by a Phyrexian agent while he was away fighting

events.summary: Eladamri outflanks Crovax's expeditionary force, but a failed rescue lets many survive, including Crovax.
events.quote: This meant that more of the Expeditionary Force survived, including Crovax.

events.summary: The Oracle declares Eladamri the true Korvecdal and warns that he must leave Rath.
events.quote: who declared him the true Korvecdal, but warned that he would have to leave Rath for another world

events.summary: Eladamri discovers Belbe looks identical to Avila, her corpse twisted into a Phyrexian pawn, and is captured.
Eladamri is tortured by Greven, escapes, and frees Takara.
events.quote: He freed the emaciated girl, and together they tried to flee the Stronghold.

events.summary: Belbe opens a portal; Eladamri poisons her with the same poison that killed Avila and flees to Dominaria.
events.quote: It quickly overpowered even Belbe’s robust physiology, killing her in a matter of seconds.

events.summary: Phyrexian airships bombard Llanowar with plague bombs, killing Takara and King Fhedusil; Eladamri guides survivors to the Dreaming Caves.
events.quote: causing enormous casualties, including Takara and the king himself

events.summary: The elves of Llanowar pledge loyalty to Eladamri, declaring him the seed of Freyalise.
events.quote: declaring him the seed of Freyalise

events.summary: Coalition forces capture the Koilos caves and destroy the Phyrexian portal with the Nine Titans.
events.quote: capturing the caves and destroying the Phyrexian portal

events.summary: Freyalise takes Eladamri and his elves to Keld and tasks him to unite his people with the Keldons.
events.quote: to unite his people with the native Keldons to aid in the defense of their lands

events.summary: At the Keldon Necropolis the risen chieftains side with the Phyrexians, forcing the Keldons to slay their dead champions.
events.quote: Unfortunately, they instead sided with their undead kin, the Phyrexians.

events.summary: Tajamin's cudgel triggers an eruption and flood, and the Golden Argosy rescues the remaining warriors and takes them to Urborg.
events.quote: The mythical Keldon longboat Golden Argosy emerged from the depths and saved the remaining warriors of Keld

events.summary: Eladamri and Grizzlegom attack the Stronghold but are held at the Portcullis, then ally with stone dwarves who tunnel in and destroy the gate from behind.
events.quote: snuck up behind Portcullis, defeated the outflanked Phyrexians, and destroyed the gate before raiding the Stronghold

events.summary: The allies find Gerrard, Squee and Urza's head in the throne room as Yawgmoth emerges as a Black Cloud of Death and they flee on Weatherlight.
events.quote: Yawgmoth began emerging through the planar portal in the throne room in the form of a Black Cloud of Death

events.summary: Eladamri and Sivi, surrounded by Yawgmoth's descending death cloud and fires, choose to fall to their deaths.
events.quote: decided to defy Yawgmoth one last time by choosing to fall to their deaths rather than let him kill them

relations.quote: later married and had a daughter, Avila

relations.note: Belbe is Avila's corpse twisted into a Phyrexian pawn
relations.quote: her corpse had been twisted into the Phyrexian pawn that stood in front of him
killing her in a matter of seconds

relations.note: Lord of Leaves, leader of the Skyshroud elves
relations.quote: Eladamri was the leader of the Skyshroud elves of Rath

relations.note: fell in love across their many battles
relations.quote: had gradually fallen in love across their many battles together

relations.note: fought Crovax's attack on the Skyshroud
relations.quote: Crovax , had decided to prove himself by attacking the Skyshroud and exterminating the rebel threat

relations.note: defied him in his last stand
relations.quote: decided to defy Yawgmoth one last time

relations.note: worshipped as the seed of Freyalise
relations.quote: declaring him the seed of Freyalise
